title: Scapegoat
summary: The scapegoat was part of the Day of Atonement ritual, symbolically carrying away Israel’s sins into the wilderness.
background: One goat was for the Lord and another was sent away after confession over it. The ritual powerfully pictures removal of guilt according to God’s appointed way.
teachingHelp: Use this with care: emphasize the text’s picture of sin removed, and let Hebrews guide Christ-centered application.
